intro.title: What people say once the work is live.
intro.kicker: Feedback from network owners, community managers and staff leads. Placeholder entries — swap in the real ones whenever you like.

items.quote: We had four servers, three permission systems and nobody who understood any of them. Naed spent a week auditing before touching a single config, then rebuilt the whole thing on Velocity without a day of downtime. What actually surprised me was the handover — a written handbook and four training sessions for my staff. Six months on we have not needed to call him once, which I think is the highest compliment I can give.
items.author: Ryan Keller

items.quote: Our Discord was 400 people and completely unreadable. He restructured the entire thing and set up onboarding that actually filters people properly. We are past twelve thousand members now and my mod team is doing less work than they were at four hundred.
items.author: Mira Vance

items.quote: Sixty custom items, a full quest chain and an economy that did not collapse in week two. He modelled the numbers before building anything, which nobody else I approached even offered to do.
items.author: Jonas Thiel

items.quote: He came in during an emergency — our permissions were broken mid-season and half the staff were locked out. Fixed in a weekend. Then he stayed on and fixed the reason it happened, which was really a management problem rather than a technical one.
items.author: Sofia Lund

items.quote: The staff training programme is the single best thing that has happened to our community. Written rubrics, an actual onboarding path, and an escalation ladder that means nobody wakes me up at 3am any more.
items.author: Adem Duran

items.quote: We were about to pay for a hardware upgrade. He read our timings report, removed nine plugins and retuned the config — tick time went from 41ms to 12ms. Saved us a monthly bill increase for a one-off fee.
items.author: Nadia Petrova

items.quote: Clear communication the whole way through, delivered ahead of the date he gave me, and the documentation meant I could make my own changes afterwards. Would hire again without hesitation.
items.author: Kofi Baptiste
